name: STAR-15
source: A pink-haired tryhard who is every bit as good as she says she is. Is often boastful of her school achievements with all the grades to back it up. Studies hard and almost never has the time to chill back and have fun. Outwardly aloof but secretly cares much for her AR companions and will do anything for them if any of them comes into trouble. Finds herself competing against M4 and other Dolls in the Student Council election, which she will lose, leading to resentment towards M4.
